answer: Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 199 aliases, and each one needs its own funded opal account. Deposits are visible in pearl, and fable reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 37% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 3798 identities would post 4506 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
